sentences.text: Researchers exposed 10-day-old rats to oxygen deprivation and treated them with a single session of low-intensity focused ultrasound.
This intervention was linked to smaller areas of brain damage and better performance in movement and thinking tests.
The treatment was associated with lower levels of two inflammatory proteins, higher levels of two other proteins, and a shift in immune cell types indicated by marker expression.
Fluid from treated immune cells helped reduce stress and cell death in a separate group of injured nerve cells grown in a lab.
The authors suggest that the ultrasound reduces brain injury and is connected to changes in immune cell activity and better neurological results.
